message:
You know those days when everything seems to go a bit off course? Just last week, we had a surprise storm rolling in, and I realized we hadn't checked our go-bags in ages. With a quick rummage, we found snacks, water bottles, and even some old flashlights. It felt like a small win that reminded us how being a little prepared can ease the chaos. 
 
We ended up cozying up with some board games while the storm raged outside, and it turned into a sweet family night we didn’t see coming. Sometimes, it’s the little things that make all the difference, right? ☂️
